summary: Exact-candidate performance measurements have not been recorded.
limitations: Development measurements or measurements from different bytes do not satisfy this gate.
requiredChecks: Self-contained hardened artifact is no larger than 10 MiB
Usable shell is interactive within 2 seconds under the documented mobile CPU-throttling profile
Every measured ECO, family, and puzzle shard load is at most 500 ms under the documented cache and CPU conditions
Legal move feedback is below 100 ms at p95 across the documented training workload
Provider-backed 250-event sync is below 500 ms at p95 in connected staging
Cumulative layout shift is below 0.1 for each measured primary route and viewport
